title: Drone Surveillance Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Exposure
metaDescription: Calculate your risk of drone surveillance with our privacy assessment tool. Evaluate location exposure, detection capabilities, and legal protections.
description: Assess your vulnerability to drone surveillance based on location, activities, and available protections. Get personalized recommendations to enhance your privacy and understand your legal rights against unauthorized aerial monitoring.

inputs.label: Property Type
inputs.helpText: Urban areas have more regulations but higher surveillance activity

inputs.label: Outdoor Activity Level
inputs.helpText: How often you spend time in outdoor spaces (1=rarely, 10=very frequently)

inputs.label: Current Privacy Protections
inputs.helpText: Existing measures to prevent or detect drone surveillance

inputs.label: Sensitive Activities
inputs.helpText: Do you engage in activities requiring high privacy (journalism, activism, etc.)?

inputs.label: Near Airport/Restricted Airspace
inputs.helpText: Are you within 5 miles of an airport or military installation?

inputs.label: Local Drone Laws
inputs.helpText: Strength of local drone privacy regulations in your area

outputFields.label: Surveillance Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall risk of drone surveillance (0-100 scale)

formula: const baseRisk = propertyType === 'urban' ? 30: propertyType === 'suburban' ? 40: propertyType === 'rural' ? 50: 35; const activityRisk = outdoorActivity * 3; const protectionReduction = privacyMeasures === 'none' ? 0: privacyMeasures === 'basic' ? 10: privacyMeasures === 'moderate' ? 20: 30; const sensitiveBonus = sensitiveActivities ? 15: 0; const airportReduction = nearAirport ? 15: 0; const lawReduction = localLaws === 'weak' ? 0: localLaws === 'moderate' ? 10: 20; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk + activityRisk + sensitiveBonus - protectionReduction - airportReduction - lawReduction)); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk': riskScore >= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk': 'Low Risk'; return { riskScore, riskLevel };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates drone surveillance risk based on location vulnerability, activity patterns, existing privacy protections, and legal framework strength. Scores consider property exposure, outdoor activity frequency, current countermeasures, and regulatory protections.
tips: Install visual barriers like privacy screens or plant tall vegetation to block aerial views of sensitive areas
Use drone detection apps or RF scanners to identify unauthorized surveillance drones in your vicinity
Know your local drone laws - many areas prohibit flying over private property without permission
Consider using a privacy-focused browser when researching drone detection tools to maintain your privacy online
Document any suspected surveillance incidents with photos, times, and locations for potential legal action

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Well-protected with good legal framework. Maintain current privacy measures and stay informed about local regulations.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some vulnerability exists. Consider adding detection tools, privacy screens, or researching local drone laws for better protection.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant surveillance exposure. Implement multiple countermeasures including detection systems, physical barriers, and legal protections.
